name: 2027 SMFM Pregnancy Meeting
venue: Gaylord National Resort and Convention Center
description: The Pregnancy Meeting is the annual scientific meeting of the Society for Maternal Fetal Medicine, featuring postgraduate courses, scientific forums, and oral and poster presentations on maternal fetal medicine. The 2027 edition takes place at the Gaylord National in National Harbor, Maryland.
